prayerExcerpt.en-US: Prayer is nothing else than union with God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A oração não é outra coisa senão a união com Deus.

meta.face: A small, thin, clean-shaven old priest of about seventy with long snow-white hair falling to his collar, a high pale smooth forehead, a narrow gentle face, deep-set luminous eyes raised in prayer.
meta.basis: Eyewitness descriptions in Monnin's Life (Bishop Ullathorne, 1854: hair white as snow, eyes deep in shadow and preternaturally bright); he refused to be photographed, so Cabuchet's bust and the 1859 deathbed photograph fixed the type. The excerpt is from his catechism on prayer.

sources.title: Monnin, Life of the Curé d'Ars (archive.org)
OnePeterFive, Could this be the face of the Curé d'Ars?
